I understand your concern about potential rate increases. However, I can't provide a yes or no answer based on your specific situation. Refinancing involves several factors such as current market rates, your credit score, and any associated fees.

I recommend checking current mortgage rates and consulting with a mortgage advisor. You can do this through our secure mobile app or by contacting our customer service line at 1-800-HELIX-CS. They can help you evaluate whether refinancing might be beneficial for you.<|im_end|>
